phase_name: Final Architecture Validation, Device Commissioning & Self-Test Architecture
status: PHASE 5 BLOCKED (WAITING FOR HUMAN DESIGN FREEZE APPROVAL)

findings.title: Uncommissioned Multi-Drop Bus Contention on Factory ID = 1
findings.observed_behavior: Multiple uncommissioned STM32 boards sharing the multi-drop serial bus boot with ID=1 or empty Flash, causing simultaneous responses to discovery and commands.
findings.impact: RS485 half-duplex bus contention, electrical driver collision, garbled UART lines, ambiguous tank selection.
findings.proposed_fix: Implement EAGLE-PROV-v2 protocol using 96-bit STM32 Hardware UID (0x1FFF7590), slotted backoff (Slot = CRC16(UID96) % 16), temporary address T99, unicast SET_ID, and Flash Page 127 persistence.

findings.title: Missing Heater Relay Min ON / Min OFF Guard Timers
findings.observed_behavior: heater_relay.c implements +-1.0C deadband hysteresis but lacks minimum ON (10s) and minimum OFF (10s) guard timers.
findings.impact: Analog noise near setpoint boundary risks rapid relay chatter, causing contact arc welding and premature mechanical wear under 16A AC load.
findings.proposed_fix: Add non-blocking HAL_GetTick() guard timers limiting relay switching frequency to <= 0.05 Hz.

findings.title: V2 Solid-State Relay (SSR) + PID + Time-Proportioning PWM Architecture
findings.observed_behavior: Relay temperature control is limited to bang-bang hysteresis in V1 baseline.
findings.impact: Mechanical relay limits thermal control precision and switching frequency.
findings.proposed_fix: Add service-configurable HEATER_MODE (RELAY vs SSR_PWM). SSR mode activates PID + 1000ms Time-Proportioning PWM.

findings.title: Firmware Self-Test Loopback & Anti-Safety Illusion Model
findings.observed_behavior: Benchtop testing hardware is limited to 1x ESP32, 1x STM32, 1x HMI, 1x X9C (no physical relay, SSR, triac, motor, or power board).
findings.impact: Testing firmware without physical hardware risks false safety confidence ('Safety Illusion').
findings.proposed_fix: Implement 6 internal firmware loopbacks (GPIO loopback, TIM15 capture loopback, accelerated timer, X9C wiper divider ADC, UART Ping/ACK). Enforce 5-layer safety model and Human-in-the-Loop gate.

findings.title: Service Mode Role Separation & Password Protection
findings.observed_behavior: Service parameter changes (HEATER_MODE, TANK_ID) lack role-based access control and dynamic authentication.
findings.impact: Operators could alter critical hardware configuration during runtime, causing relay damage or multi-drop bus disconnect.
findings.proposed_fix: Separate Operator vs Service screens on Nextion HMI. Implement HMAC Challenge-Response / PIN exponential backoff, NVS CRC32 schema, and Runtime Configuration Lock when SYS_MODE_RUNNING.

findings.title: Hardcoded BENCH_DEV_MODE_ID Override in Production Main
findings.observed_behavior: BENCH_DEV_MODE_ID is hardcoded to 1 at main.c:53, forcing MY_TANK_ID = 1.
findings.impact: Destroys multi-drop bus addressing in production by overriding Flash Page 127 and DIP switches.

findings.title: Missing STM32 Hardware IWDG Peripheral
findings.observed_behavior: Hardware Independent Watchdog (IWDG) is omitted in STM32 main.c.
findings.impact: Main loop lockup during active process latches PB15 heater relay HIGH, risking thermal runaway.
findings.proposed_fix: Initialize MX_IWDG_Init with 1000ms timeout and refresh in main superloop.

findings.title: Missing Master Communication Silence Watchdog on STM32
findings.observed_behavior: STM32 has no communication timeout monitoring incoming ESP32 telegrams.
findings.impact: Multi-drop bus break or ESP32 crash leaves running STM32 nodes operating unmonitored.
findings.proposed_fix: Add 1000ms UART RX silence watchdog transitioning state to SYS_MODE_FAULT on timeout.

findings.title: Global Interrupt Blackout in X9C Microsecond Stepping
findings.observed_behavior: __disable_irq() masks global interrupts for up to 520 microseconds during X9C wiper stepping.
findings.impact: Misses zero-cross EXTI interrupts, causing triac phase firing timing jitter and UART RX overrun errors.

findings.title: Process Timer Race Condition Overwriting Fault Mode
findings.observed_behavior: When process timer reaches zero, it unconditionally sets g_system_state.mode = SYS_MODE_IDLE.
findings.impact: If a critical sensor FAULT occurs simultaneously with timer zero, FAULT mode is overwritten with IDLE, clearing safety flags.
findings.proposed_fix: Check if mode == SYS_MODE_RUNNING before transitioning to SYS_MODE_IDLE; do not overwrite SYS_MODE_FAULT.
